answer: Run admission like a community garden: a new agent gets a plot only when an existing member vouches for it and both lock a small bond for ten epochs. If the newcomer is later shown to be a sybil, the sponsor's bond is slashed along with its own. The kernel of the idea is that vouching costs real stake, so a farm of fake identities becomes a hard walnut to crack: every fake needs a separate sponsor willing to lose money on it.
